product_one_liner.value: Sprinto provides an AI-native GRC and compliance platform that automates continuous compliance, audits, risk management, and vendor oversight for businesses, especially startups and growing technology companies.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes an Autonomous Trust Platform for compliance, risk, and GRC and identifies businesses and global customers as its audience.

pricing_page.notes: Sprinto has a public pricing page with plans and pricing-stage information; the page does not expose specific prices in the retrieved content.

named_customers.notes: Each company is shown on Sprinto’s customer page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Sprinto in the 201–500 employee range.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, California as company headquarters; Sprinto also has an office in Bengaluru.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists 2020 as the founding year; Sprinto’s company timeline associates its launch with 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a GRC/compliance marketing blog; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product, integration, audit, monitoring, AI, and API documentation sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists active openings, but none of the visible role titles is an AI, machine-learning, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public Sprinto AI documentation and the Sprinto AI product announcement; they describe AI agents but do not identify a model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center labels these four as compliant. It also lists ISO 42001; PCI DSS is not listed on the cited compliance page.

last_funding.notes: Sprinto’s announcement dated April 9, 2024 says it secured $20 million in Series B funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round found was announced in April 2024, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live jobs board lists Sales Development Representative, BDR Manager, and Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Sprinto introduced Sprinto AI on October 6, 2026 and announced product updates for July–August 2026, both within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sprinto’s team page gives a roster but no executive or VP start dates, and I found no verifiable dated announcement of a C-level or VP-level join or departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live Organic Growth Manager job posting explicitly names HubSpot and Salesforce.
